groups.title: Testing Patterns
groups.question: Explain how you would test a Go HTTP service, from small functions to full handlers.

followUps.Table-Driven Tests: What does a table-driven test look like, and why does t.Run help when one case fails?
followUps.httptest for Handler Testing: How does httptest.NewRecorder let you test a handler without starting a real server?

groups.title: Test Isolation
groups.question: Explain how you keep Go tests fast and reliable, including tests of concurrent code.

followUps.Interface Mocking: Why are Go's small, implicit interfaces easy to mock?
followUps.The Race Detector: Why might a race condition pass tests many times, and how does go test -race catch it?

groups.title: Benchmarking
groups.question: Explain how you would measure whether a change made Go code faster.

followUps.Writing Benchmarks: Why must a benchmark use the result of the code it measures?
followUps.Benchmark Comparison with benchstat: A benchmark got 5% faster. How does benchstat tell you whether that is real or noise?

groups.title: Integration Testing
groups.question: Explain how you test that your Go code really works with the database, and how you judge test coverage.

followUps.Testing with a Real Database: What do tests against a real PostgreSQL in a container catch that mocks can't?
followUps.Test Coverage & go tool cover: Your coverage is 100%. Why might important behavior still be untested?
